topPRs.title: Add Optimism Knowledge MCP server
topPRs.author: MSilb7
topPRs.body:
- Adds a new MCP (Model Context Protocol) server that gives Claude Code access to Optimism documentation, specs, and GitHub
   resources                                                                                                                 
  - Provides 10 tools for searching and fetching Optimism knowledge with strict context efficiency (max 5 results, 2000 char 
  limits)                                                                                                                    
  - Includes sync mechanism to keep the knowledge index up-to-date as Optimism docs evolve                                   
                                                                                                                             
  ## Tools                                                                                                                   
                                                                                                                             
  **Search (Phase 1 - lightweight)**                                                                                         
  - `get_resource_index` - Overview of available resources                                                                   
  - `list_github_repos` - List ethereum-optimism repos                                                                       
  - `search_optimism_github` - Search code in repos                                                                          
  - `search_optimism_docs` - Search docs.optimism.io                                                                         
  - `search_optimism_specs` - Search specs.optimism.io                                                                       
                                                                                                                             
  **Fetch (Phase 2 - content)**                                                                                              
  - `get_optimism_doc` - Fetch doc page content                                                                              
  - `get_optimism_spec` - Fetch spec section content                                                                         
  - `get_github_file` - Fetch file from GitHub                                                                               
                                                                                                                             
  **Maintenance**                                                                                                            
  - `check_index_freshness` - Check if index is stale                                                                        
  - `sync_resource_index` - Sync from upstream sources                                                                       
                                                                                                                             
  ## Test plan                                                                                                               
                                                                                                                             
  - [x] Server initializes and lists all 10 tools                                                                            
  - [x] `get_resource_index` returns docs/specs/github overview                                                              
  - [x] `list_github_repos` fetches repos from ethereum-optimism org                                                         
  - [x] `get_github_file` fetches file content (README.md)                                                                   
  - [x] `get_optimism_spec` fetches specs (after URL fix)                                                                    
  - [x] `get_optimism_doc` fetches documentation                                                                             
  - [x] `npm run sync` updates resource index from upstream                                                                  
  - [x] `check_index_freshness` reports sync status                                                                          
                                                                                                                             
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)
